title: Chapter 79: Zerg'S Ability To Mass-Produce Troops
content:
Chapter 79: Zerg'S Ability To Mass-Produce Troops

The bear goblin cavalry was strong and fast. Even though they were attacked by the elite troops of the alliance, some of them still rushed to the vicinity of the alliance army.

Some of the Zerg puppies on both sides of the alliance army rushed out and interrupted the charge of the bear goblin cavalry.

At this moment, the number of Zerg puppies on the battlefield was limited. The puppies that rushed up did not fight the bear goblin cavalry head-on, but just wandered around and fought. The precise shooting of the feathered cavalry archers in the rear would shoot and kill these bear goblin cavalry one by one.

The other 4,000 elite troops of the alliance continued to launch attacks on the densely populated area of the charging bear goblin infantry, preventing the charge of the bear goblin army from forming an effective continuous impact on the alliance army.

There were constantly lucky bear goblin infantry cavalry who rushed up to fight with the Zerg puppies, bypassing the attacks of javelins and hand axes, and the Zerg puppies were also constantly sending troops to join the battle.

When the troops of both sides in the melee area reached a certain density, both sides lost the space to maneuver, and the tragic close combat began!

The elite troops of the alliance were stimulated by the fierce melee in front and burst out with unprecedented combat power!

Faster, more fierce and more accurate long-range attacks quickly cleared the bear goblin infantry and cavalry blocking the rear of the melee area!

All the Zerg puppies have pounced on them, and with the assistance of the Feather Clan Archers, they quickly eliminated the enemies in the melee area.

Nearly 10,000 bear goblin infantry and cavalry fell in front of the alliance army. Their combat power is not weak, and they should have been blessed by the priests before the war.

But without the close command of the priests, these troops did not show super-strong blessings such as frenzy.

A beautiful annihilation battle, the elite troops of the alliance army were not damaged, but except for the Feather Clan Archers, the long-range attack weapons of other troops were basically exhausted.

After a fierce melee fight, the number of Zerg puppies was only more than a thousand, and they were almost wiped out.

Wu Qing was very satisfied that the alliance army eliminated nearly 10,000 elite bear goblin troops so quickly with such losses.

"Prepare to retreat!"

Wu Qing issued the order to retreat.

If the battle continues, the elite troops of the alliance will rush up for close combat. No matter how strong they are, the losses in close combat will become uncontrollable.

Although these elite troops are still in high spirits and ready to rush up to fight at any time, such consumption is completely unnecessary in Wu Qing's view.

The alliance is still too weak now. The assets of these five major territories are all good seeds and should not be wasted here now.

Wu Qing wants to keep them well and let them play a greater role as the alliance grows stronger.

The bear goblin army saw the powerful strength displayed by the alliance army, and under the leadership of a bear goblin priest, they gathered nearly 10,000 troops and rushed over.

The number of Zerg troops is not enough, so there is no need to fight this battle. The Zerg puppies are the rear guard, and the elite troops of the alliance turned around and retreated under the command of Meng.

This time they really retreated. Wu Qing did not intend to let the elite troops of the alliance participate in the remaining battles.

The army of bear goblins guarded the huge transport team and did not pursue them. They watched the alliance army withdraw calmly.

When the alliance army left the sight of the evil god army, Wu Qing ordered the lurking puppies to go out and kill the small army of the evil god camp and any intelligent creatures in the enemy camp.

This made the evil god army instantly lose the trace of the alliance army. Under the guidance of Wu Qing, the alliance army turned left and right and soon passed through the outer defense line organized by the evil god army, found a safe place, and stopped to rest.

Five thousand elite alliance troops, plus less than a thousand Zerg puppies, are the remaining forces of the alliance army now.

The Tengu guide was protected by Wu Qing's personal guards and the ten Zerg heavy cavalry throughout the journey, and was in a state of confusion all the way.

He only knew that the alliance army kept running and fighting, and in the end only these people were left.

A tiny individual, in the game, can't understand many things, just like being in a cage, a person's eyes can see very limited things.

…

Around the supply line of the evil god army, the withdrawal of the alliance army did not quell the war here, and the Zerg troops went on the field alone.

Two thousand Zerg Hydralisks and more than a thousand Zerglings, taking advantage of the powerful battlefield information, jumped up and down under the heavy siege of the evil god army, and seemed to be at ease.

With two thousand Hydralisks led by one-star Hydralisks, the long-range killing ability is terrifying. The evil god army with insufficient troops surrounded them, and under the terrifying volley of Hydralisks, they were beaten to pieces in a few seconds.

With the real-time battlefield intelligence provided by the Zerglings lurking everywhere, as long as they are not surrounded by multiple evil god armies, the core combat power of this Zerg is temporarily safe and worry-free.

In the Zerg territory, with a large amount of gas resources provided on the battlefield, a thousand Hydralisks were quickly hatched and rushed to the battlefield in batches.

A large number of Zerglings gathered and lurked in the vicinity of the evil god army camp, waiting for Wu Qing's orders.

When a thousand Hydralisks arrived, the number of Zerglings that had gathered again exceeded 20,000.

More than 20,000 Zerglings and a thousand Hydralisks did not wait for the follow-up troops, and headed straight for the huge transport team that was still stationed there.

Along the way, they encountered several small-scale evil god armies, which were instantly overwhelmed by the Zerg with an absolute advantage in numbers, without even a wave.

Behind this Zerg army, at every distance, there was a team of about 200 Zerglings, constantly chasing the footsteps of the large army.

Such a Zerg squad stretched all the way to the Zerg territory, seemingly endless!

This is the fighting power of the Zerg when there is no population limit and sufficient resources!

The total number of Zerg combat units is increasing rapidly. As long as the battle in front continues, the Zerg's violent state can be maintained!

Wu Qing now wants to use the Zerg to break a certain balance between the two sides of the confrontation and let this inevitable war break out immediately!

Wu Qing wants the Zerg to complete enough accumulation in this war, so that the Alliance can gain a foothold in the gap between the two camps after the war!

The evil god camp is definitely an enemy, but the local race camp is not necessarily a friend.

The only way to have a foothold is to make yourself strong enough!

…

The two thousand hydralisks and more than a thousand puppies entangled with the evil god army near the evil god army camp no longer fought and retreated with the evil god army that surrounded them, but used the speed and information advantages to quickly avoid the sight of the evil god army and disappeared.

Their target was also the bear goblin guards who had just fought with the Alliance army. Wu Qing was not going to let go of such a huge transport team.

More than 3,000 Zerg troops, with small targets and fast speed, passed through the gaps between the evil god armies and quickly broke out of the encirclement of the evil god army.

They headed east, and the huge and bloated target was in front of them.
